topReviews.name: Pagidimarry Jyothirmai
topReviews.text:
I visited F3 Cafe & Bistro recently had a very pleasant experience. The place was clean, comfortable, and had a nice atmosphere that made it easy to relax and enjoy the meal.
The food was fresh and well prepared. The flavors were good, and the portions were satisfying. Everything was served nicely, and it was clear that care was taken in the cooking.
The service was friendly and polite. The staff were helpful and made sure we were comfortable throughout the visit. Even when the restaurant got busy, they remained calm and attentive.
The prices were reasonable for the quality of food and service provided. Overall, it was a positive experience, and I would recommend this restaurant to others. I would also be happy to visit again in the future. 😀😁

topReviews.name: Lasya Priya
topReviews.text:
The cafe was neat. The staff were friendly and the food was delicious. Their blueberry cheesecake was amazing and so was the white sauce pasta.
Their drinks need improvement. We tried the orange one and it had way too much mint for our liking.
My friends got other non-vegetarian items and said that the roasted chicken,egg noodles with chicken curry tasted delicious.
Fish and chips were a disappointment. The fries were crispy and delicious though.
Worth visiting with your friends or even alone.

topReviews.name: Parizad Major
topReviews.text:
It was highly recommended by our family and it did not disappoint. The food, its pricing, the service - all was excellent! We had bolognaise pizza, lamb pepperoni pizza, grilled lamb burger, fish and chips, grilled chicken, mexican chicken and rice, chicken sizzler and loads of drinks amongst the 8 of us. The bill was reasonable and the quantity plus quality was amazing!
Booking via Swiggy dineout got us a discount too. Definitely worth visiting again!

allReviews.name: Avinash Deepak
allReviews.text:
TERRIBLE OVERALL EXPERIENCE

Horrible Ambience

The ambience was extremely unpleasant & uncomfortable. The place felt chaotic rather than enjoyable.

Extremely Loud

The noise levels were unbearable. Between the music, staff movement & unruly customers, we literally walked out with a headache.

Poor Crowd Management

The table next to us was extremely loud, disruptive & completely inconsiderate. The staff did nothing to manage the situation.

Service Was Shockingly Bad

The service was honestly terrible. The staff struggled to understand even basic requests & ended up bringing the wrong order. Everything felt rushed, confused & unprofessional.

Food Was Good

The only positive was the food. The dishes themselves were actually quite good & probably the only reason this review is not even harsher.

Ratings Feel Manipulated

Looking at the actual experience versus the online ratings, the reviews seem heavily inflated or fudged. This place simply does not deserve such high ratings.

Final Verdict

A loud, chaotic & poorly managed experience with terrible service. Good food alone cannot compensate for such a lousy dining experience. Definitely not going back.

allReviews.text:
We tried Pad Thai, spaghetti, and Veracruz dishes, and taste-wise all three were good and satisfying. The flavors were well balanced and enjoyable. We also had soup, a classic latte, and hot chocolate, and everything tasted good and comforting, especially the beverages.
The service was decent and smooth, with no major issues during our visit. The staff was attentive enough and made the experience pleasant overall.
We were seated on the terrace, which is a nice option and offers a good setting to sit and relax. However, personally, the ground floor ambiance felt much better in terms of overall vibe and comfort. One major downside was the presence of mosquitoes. There were a lot of mosquitoes all over the area, which was quite disturbing and affected the dining experience, especially while sitting on the terrace.
Overall, the food quality is good and the place has a nice setup with both terrace and ground floor seating. With better mosquito control and a bit more attention to outdoor comfort, the experience could be much better and more enjoyable.

Here, after ordering starters and drinks, the main course arrived, and there was ANOTHER cockroach, this time IN the pizza. Not just that, the next day, a few members of the group fell sick. I do have to appreciate the service of the staff who not only cooperated with our requests but also compensated us. However, good service does not make up for whatever hygiene situation they have going on in the kitchen. Will not be returning until something is done about this, we come to such spots expecting cleanliness, just to have 2 pest encounters in 1 trip.
